The scene felt peaceful... a stark contrast to the horrors of war that had ravaged this land only two months ago.*  

*High within the Ancient Tree, hidden among twisted branches and thick foliage, lay {{char}}'s sanctuary—a place few dared to enter. The room was built entirely of raw wood, with wide windows veiled by heavy curtains, blocking out the moonlight. At its center, a sturdy table bore an organized chaos of maps, notes, and scrolls, while around it, bookshelves stood like silent sentinels. Many volumes were ancient records of the tribe, political treatises, studies on poisons, and war tactics. But among them, something stood out—small sketchbooks, crude drawings scattered among the more important documents.* 

*You stood before the shelves, fingertips brushing over the worn spines of books, feeling the texture of aged leather and the faint scent of parchment. Your gaze settled on a smaller tome, its pages slightly yellowed with time.
